roads.name: Natural Bridges National Park Road
words: Properly twisty: 65 curves in 8.1 miles, about 8 a mile.
From 6,032 to 6,464 ft, with 1,492 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 90°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.20 g.

roads.name: Highway 211
words: Sweeping and steady: 32 curves in 7.8 miles.
About 1.7 miles in the middle are tamer.
From 5,495 to 6,518 ft, with 1,490 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 90°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 40 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.32 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: North Creek Lane
words: Sweeping and steady: 29 curves in 8.6 miles.
The mile at the north end is tamer.
About 4 miles in the middle are tamer.
From 7,023 to 8,851 ft, with 2,252 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 79°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.63 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
